description: This Dart source file defines the LessonRepository class, which provides an abstraction layer for fetching lesson data via a LessonService. It includes methods to list lessons and retrieve a lesson by ID, utilizing dependency injection for the service implementation.

classes.name: LessonRepository
classes.description: A repository class managing lesson data fetching via a LessonService. It offers methods to list all lessons and get a lesson by ID.

methods.name: LessonRepository
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the repository with a LessonService instance, defaulting to MockLessonService if none provided.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Fetches and returns a list of lessons from the underlying LessonService.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific lesson by its ID using the LessonService.
